revision_reason: The diagnostic-only announcement probe showed two source-routing defects before any numerical reconstruction or holdout inspection: official NSE announcement metadata already states the result period end for life insurers, while the generic financial-results default route can return a non-empty but incomplete history for NESTLEIND. V1.1 fixes those source-collection defects without using valuation outcomes.
scope: Only the five residual development symbols from the 270/300 baseline source map. No holdout valuation targets may be fetched.

LTIM.reason: LTIMindtree Limited renamed LTM Limited; NSE symbol changed to LTM effective 2026-04-17.

TATAMOTORS.reason: Old TATAMOTORS security renamed Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited with symbol TMPV effective 2025-10-24 after demerger mechanics.

nestle_calendar_year_rule: For development dates before Nestle India's FY transition, an audited consolidated or standalone 31-Dec result disseminated before the signal cutoff may supply the latest annual book source when the generic Annual endpoint omits that historical calendar-year record. Consolidated remains preferred where available.
structured_history_rule: For residual symbols, always query both the default financial-results route and the explicit frozen historical date window and union/deduplicate the records. A non-empty default response is not proof of complete history.

announcement_fallback.metadata_period_end_rule: First use an exact period-end statement in official NSE announcement metadata such as 'period ended June 30, 2023', 'quarter ... ended September 30, 2022', or a quarter-end month/year phrase such as 'period ended June 2022'. Month/year inference is allowed only for Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec and maps to the corresponding calendar quarter end.
announcement_fallback.pdf_period_end_fallback_rule: If official announcement metadata does not state the period end, use the latest quarter-end date visible in the official financial-result attachment that is no later than dissemination date and no more than 120 days old.
announcement_fallback.annual_rule: A 31-Mar filing (or 31-Dec for NESTLEIND under the frozen calendar-year rule) is annual only when the official attachment contains an audited indicator after removing the token UNAUDITED.
announcement_fallback.financial_result_metadata_rule: Eligible announcement metadata must explicitly refer to financial result(s), or to financial statements for an ended reporting period. Generic investor material, trading-window notices and earnings-call material are not sufficient.

success_goal: Resolve all 30 baseline company-month source gaps using official NSE identity continuity or official NSE filing evidence. Anything unresolved remains an explicit gap; no imputation or secondary finance-site substitution is allowed.
holdout_guardrail: No Nifty dashboard or official holdout P/E/P/B/dividend-yield target URL may be requested or stored by this stage.
